ios.desc:
Lying awake scrolling your phone at night?
CalmNest guides you to sleep naturally with science-backed breathing techniques.

— 4 BREATHING METHODS —

Rhythmic Breathing: Actively follow the on-screen slider to build a steady breathing rhythm that calms your mind.
Box Breathing: Inhale 4s → Hold 4s → Exhale 4s → Hold 4s. A proven pattern used by athletes and military to reduce stress.
4-7-8 Breathing: Inhale 4s → Hold 7s → Exhale 8s. The classic slow-exhale pattern for falling asleep.
Relaxation Breathing: Breathe in naturally, exhale slowly, and sink into deep relaxation.

— SLEEP INSIGHTS —

Understand your sleep patterns with 7-day analytics:
- Sleep onset trend (actual & 3-day moving average)
- Breathing method effectiveness comparison
- Weekly sleep pattern analysis
- Sleep quality score & consistency rating
- Personalized optimal sleep time recommendation

— SMART WAKE ALARM —

Set a wake time and your session ends automatically. Choose from 3 alarm sounds with preview support.

— LIVE MONITORING —

Track your session in real time through Dynamic Island and Lock Screen widgets. See elapsed time, breathing count, and helpful sleep tips at a glance.

— CUSTOMIZABLE —

- Auto brightness adjustment (min/max settings)
- Background music & breathing guide sounds
- Adjustable slider size (short/medium/long)
- Supports English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified Chinese

Focus on your breathing before bed.

— Subscription Details —
• CalmNest Premium
• Length: 1 month or 1 year, automatically renewed each period
• Price: see in-app pricing for your region
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal turned off in your Account Settings on the App Store

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.pentarab.com/calmnest/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.pentarab.com/calmnest/privacy

show_hn.title: Show HN: CalmNest – Helping you put your phone down and fall asleep

quotes.text:
Hi HN
I built CalmNest because I couldn’t stop scrolling at night. Most nights, I’d tell myself I’d sleep soon — but then an hour would vanish as I kept holding my phone, reading, checking things, or just staring at the screen until I fell asleep with it in my hand.

I wanted to change that — not by cutting myself off completely, but by turning my phone into something that guides me to sleep instead of keeping me awake.

So I made CalmNest, a calm space that helps you slow down and drift into sleep naturally. It gently guides your breathing with subtle visuals, dims as you relax, and eventually fades to a soft “Good night” screen when you stop interacting. From there, it tracks your sleep time and patterns — no pressure, no notifications, just calm.

Normally it’s $5.99, but it’s free until November 17 for anyone who wants to try it. If you, like me, tend to fall asleep holding your phone, maybe this can help.

https://apps.apple.com/st/app/calmnest-sleep-relax/id6754578929

Would love to hear your thoughts — especially from anyone who’s struggled with the same “phone at midnight” habit.
